asked: # Build: re-sync-stuck-branches-lander-can-push ## Brett said (verbatim) At: 2026-11-16T16:29:34.116Z > Put fix main on more than one slot, they won't conflict. ## What to build Continue build "Re-sync stuck branches so the lander can push them" (re-sync-stuck-branches-lander-can-push) — Phase 1, model Opus. What Brett asked for (build-origin@1, his words come first; a paraphrase never replaces them): Brett said (2026-11-16 16:29): "Put fix main on more than one slot, they won't conflict." Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first. Steps ≤ 10 min. Checkpoints: Steps are checkpoints inside this ONE session, not separate tasks: work through them in order without stopping between them; when a step is finished, commit it on your branch, push, then tick it done before starting the next (orchestrator.mjs act step <build> <stepId> done; the VPS opens and links the PR). Nothing is lost if the session dies: the next session picks up at the first open step on the same branch. Never ask for a new prompt or a relaunch per step. Look: UI code (handwritten or generated) conforms to the hot-swappable asset system: every colour, size, spacing, font, radius and border comes from asset tokens (--fx-* colour/style, --fx-type-* / --fx-dens-* / --fx-size-* scale, --fx-radius-*, --fx-border-w; Kotlin: Axf.colors / Axf.type / Axf.space / Axf.shapes), framework controls instead of raw ones, no var() fallbacks. `node framework/cli/check-theme.mjs` and `check-controls.mjs` must pass (CI fails otherwise); `node framework/cli/scale-adopt.mjs <path>` moves most literals onto the tokens. API: Everything comes with an API (Brett, Nov 8 2026): anything this build adds or changes that has a UI gets full API control: a deep link that opens it (console_show / console_open target), its state readable, and every action and setting it offers callable without the UI, through the console API (REST), MCP tools (console actions, plugin commands, control@1 for tokens and planner items), the CLI and voice (AmberX), all four the same. A UI-only feature is not done; say in the PR how each one is reached. Steps in this phase (10 left, ~1.4 h): [ ] s1 (~6 min) Inventory: list the 4 stuck branches, the 2 stray branches and the auto-lander-controls worktree; for each record local vs origin heads, ahead/behind counts and open PRs into a scratch note (no changes yet). Confirm no axf-data / Postgres branch is in scope. [ ] s2 (~8 min) Re-sync server-gate-one-session-per-build-no: fetch origin, merge origin's branch into local (keep both sides' commits, resolve store/THREADS with the merge drivers or take main's), push normally (no force). [ ] s3 (~8 min) Re-sync one-source-truth-console-shows-only-what the same way: merge origin into local keeping both sides, resolve conflicts, plain push. [ ] s4 (~8 min) Re-sync console-axhub-retry-failed-calls the same way: merge origin into local keeping both sides, resolve conflicts, plain push. [ ] s5 (~8 min) Re-sync demo-video-series-three-minute-browser the same way: merge origin into local keeping both sides, resolve conflicts, plain push. [ ] s6 (~8 min) Drop the stray branches merge-main-land-one-source-truth-console and land-native-bridge-mic: first confirm every commit on each is already on main or on its real build branch (git cherry), note any that aren't in the report and keep them on a backup tag; then delete local + remote (remote delete through the GitHub App token, veto reason). [ ] s7 (~9 min) auto-lander-controls-in-the-gate-plugin: review the worktree's uncommitted diff file by file; commit what belongs to the build (gate plugin / lander controls), drop the rest…
